svg.title: Where the length profiles differ
svg.desc: Nine panels share a zero to forty percent scale: the manuscript target and all eight languages in alphabetical order. All languages use the same blue bars. Lengths nine and above are combined for display only.

g.text: Percent of words; same scale in each panel
Horizontal axis: counted units per word.
9+ is a display group, not the scoring bins.
Different units require a cipher assumption.
